text:
deploy-bot: starting staggered rollout slice 7/12 for v2 -> v1 split on api.redwood.com. deploy-id=rb-7009876543. watch window 15m, operators @ashley @tim. rolling route /generate -> v2 default unless tenant pinned.
ashley: picking this up — quick heads up: mobile SDKs flagged earlier for header mismatch when Accept-Version is absent. will pre-check mobile-heavy tenants for pinning.
tim: during smoke we saw a ~2.8x 429 spike for EU region under simulated mobile load. recommending hold for EU tenants with >25% mobile traffic. proposing immediate pin for t-221 and t-332.
maria: ok — set rollback triggers: if errors >= 5% sustained over 5m OR 3x baseline 429s, initiate rollback. also add latency circuit: median p50 > 600ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> auto-fallback to v1.
leo: forwarding to mobile SDK lead, will patch quick docs. release notes need a small section on header behavior and client retry guidance. suggest adding this snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Api-Version: v2" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
ashley: ops command ready for pin, example: `deploybot pin-tenant --id t-221 --route v1 --reason "mobile 429 spike" --expires 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: pin requested for t-221 by ashley, executing now.
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-221 -> v1 (rb-7009876543-pin1).
maria: dashboards updated: added temp panel for v2 429s by region + tenant. alerting rule duplicate: v2_429_ratio_eu > 0.03 for 5m triggers runbook.
tim: holding rollout for slice 7 until 30m post-pin stability check. if metrics stable then proceed to slice 8/12.
leo: noted — sending short notice to SDK on-call and adding a line to release notes draft: "Clients without an explicit X-Api-Version header may receive v1 results; recommend explicit header for v2 behavior and graceful retries on 429s." link: https://go.redwood/release-notes/v2-draft (internal).
ashley: added a short canary test to the smoke pipeline: 100 mobile-style requests across EU and US, check p50 and 429s. script lives in ci/deploy/canaries/v2_mobile_check.sh.
maria: will watch for SLO breaches and escalate to infra on-call if circuit trips. setting pager if fallback occurs.
tim: thumbs up. we'll also snapshot traffic for post-mortem if we need rollback.
ashley: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single record for the pin + hold decision. will update when slice 7 resumes or if we roll back. :eyes:
leo: acknowledged, will update the SDK changelog and ping partners channel once we clear the 30m check.
